text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Das Businessmodell umfasst Wasserstofflastwagen, -tankstellen sowie Produktion und Logistik des erneuerbaren Wasserstoffs.", "gist": "The business model includes hydrogen trucks, hydrogen stations, and production and logistics of renewable hydrogen."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "rund 50", "gist": "Approximately 50"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "über 1'000", "gist": "Over 1,000"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Auch das Ausland beobachtet diese Entwicklung mit grossem Interesse.", "gist": "Foreign countries are observing this development with great interest."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Kategorie Gebäude und Raum", "gist": "Category: Buildings and Space"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Mettiss AG", "gist": "Mettiss AG"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Beat Kegel", "gist": "Beat Kegel"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Herr Kegels Gespür für die Physik – Die Mettiss AG und Beat Kegel haben ein Gebäude aus den 1960er Jahr dank intelligenter Planung von einer Energieschleuder zum Passivhaus saniert", "gist": "Mr. Kegel's sense for physics – Mettiss AG and Beat Kegel renovated a building from the 1960s into a passive house through intelligent planning."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Die meisten älteren Bürogebäude der Schweiz sind Energieschleudern.", "gist": "Most older office buildings in Switzerland are energy guzzlers."}]}
